rows.en:
Clear the "Macross Frontier"
missions in a row
rows.notes: Japanese 'Macross F'; glossary work title 'Macross Frontier'.

rows.en:
You will now take on the 23 "Macross Frontier" missions back to back.
Expect long, fierce fighting. Steel yourself and go!
Annihilate the returning Victors.

The Victors that struck Macross Frontier never left; they seem to be hiding
in Island 3's foundation block. Annihilate them before they near Island 1.

Wipe out the Vajra that suddenly
appeared during the survey of their nest.
rows.notes: Prefilled; kept. Re-broken to the Japanese line sizes (40 / 44 bytes).

rows.en:
Wipe out the rioting
Zentradi.

A concert tour crew visiting planet Gallia 4 to boost morale has been taken
hostage by rioting Zentradi. Wipe out the rioting Zentradi to rescue them.

Organized Vajra attacks have put the Frontier fleet in grave danger.
Head for the giant Vajra ship believed to be giving orders. Destroy it at once.

Wipe out the deserters trying to escape
in the stolen Macross Quarter.

Some S.M.S. members are trying to hijack the Macross Quarter and escape.
At this rate they'll fold away. You're authorized to shoot down the deserters.

Clear the "False Songstress"
missions in a row
rows.notes: Glossary short form for tight UI ('The False Songstress' in full).

rows.en:
You will now take on the 6 "False Songstress" missions back to back.
Expect long, fierce fighting. Steel yourself and go!
rows.notes: Same short form as u3175 for consistency.

rows.en:
Clear the "Super Dimension Fortress
Macross II" missions in a row
rows.notes: Japanese gives the full title of Macross II. Break moved: a 47-byte objective line was longer than any Japanese line (46).

rows.en:
You will now take on the 7 "Super Dimension Fortress Macross II" missions back to back.
Expect long, fierce fighting. Steel yourself and go!

Win consecutive battles
against ace pilots
rows.notes: x3. No final period, as in the Japanese and the other chain objectives.

rows.en:
You will now fight ace pilots in battle after battle.
Expect grueling, fierce combat. Steel yourself and go!

Win consecutive
battles against bosses

You will now fight the bosses in battle after battle.
Expect grueling, fierce combat. Steel yourself and go!
Seize victory from Roy Focker.

Roy Focker: the U.N. ace who loves booze, women, and above all the open sky.
Defeat Focker, whose skills have made him the very model of a pilot.
Seize victory from Shin Kudo.

Shin Kudo washed up on Mayan Island and grew through the many people he met.
Defeat Shin, the idiot who'd throw his life away for the woman he holds dear.

Seize victory from the duo
of Ivanov and Nora.

D.D. Ivanov and Nora Polyansky: the aces of the Anti-U.N. Forces.
Defeat this dangerous couple, whose skills ran the U.N. Forces ragged.
Seize victory from the Bird Human.

Sara Nome, Guide of the Wind, charged with stopping the Bird Human's revival.
Defeat the Bird Human, revived in spite of all her efforts.

Seize victory from the genius Max
and the ace Milia.

Genius pilot Max and ace Milia, who made the first-ever interstellar marriage.
Defeat the Jenius couple, also a bridge to peace with the Zentradi.

Seize victory from
Quamzin Kravshera.

Quamzin Kravshera, boss of the Quamzin family, notorious as the Ally Killer.
Defeat Boss Quamzin, in such a fine mood he's riding a Destroid Monster.
Seize victory from Golg Boddole Zer.

Golg Boddole Zer: Zentradi Supreme Commander over a full 5 million ships.
Defeat the ruthless Boddole Zer, who'd readily kill his own troops to win.
rows.notes: Prefilled; kept. Shortened: briefing lines hold 78 bytes (2 lines). Shortened: briefing lines hold 78 bytes (2 lines).

rows.en:
Seize victory from the duo
of Isamu and Guld.

Isamu and Guld: stuck together since childhood, they fight whenever they meet.
Defeat the Dalmatian High School duo, seemingly at odds but friends at heart.
Seize victory from Captain Max.
Maximilian Jenius, space carrier Battle 7's captain and a commander of genius. Defeat the Battle 7, which fought its way through the fierce Protodeviln war.
rows.notes: Prefilled (MUF). Review: the Japanese has no real line break, only a full-width yen-n typo between the two sentences (MUF noted it would display literally and shipped an ASCII backslash-n break there). This cell is not a backslash-n cell (lit_nl false, no WRAP), and insert_text refuses a real newline in a CSV cell, so the English is one line. FOR THE BUILD LEAD: about 965 px on one line will not fit the 2-line briefing box; break it after 'genius.' (mark the occurrence lit_nl or WRAP) if the build should match MUF.

rows.en: Seize victory from Gavil and Glavil.

Gavil, a Protodeviln with a unique sense of beauty, and Glavil, a monster-like
Protodeviln of immense combat power. Defeat the Beauty and the Monster.
Triumph over His Excellency Gepelnitchi.
rows.notes: Prefilled; kept ('Triumph over' rather than 'Seize victory from', fine).

rows.en:
His Excellency Gepelnitchi: Varauta supreme commander, mightiest Protodeviln.
Defeat His Excellency Gepelnitchi, who could drain the galaxy of its Spiritia.
Seize victory from Gamlin Kizaki.

Gamlin Kizaki, elite pilot of the U.N. Forces' Diamond Force.
Defeat Gamlin, nicknamed "Martian" as a child for his wide forehead.

Seize victory from the duo
of Basara and Graham.

Graham, who hates and would kill the Galaxy Whales, and Basara, who was
moved to sing to them. Defeat these men burning with passion for the whales.
Seize victory from Ozma Lee.

Ozma Lee: seasoned S.M.S. Skull Squadron leader, overprotective of his sister.
Defeat Ozma, who smashed death flag after death flag throughout the story.

Seize victory from Jeffrey,
captain of the Macross Quarter.

The Macross Quarter: ARMD-class in size, yet it bears the name Macross.
Defeat the Macross Quarter, captained by Jeffrey Wilder.
Seize victory from Klan Klang.

Klan Klang, Pixie Team leader, clumsy not just in her genes but in love too.
Defeat Klan, a maiden sunk in rage and grief after losing the one she loved.

Seize victory from the duo
of Alto and Brera.

"Being linked to you made it clear. However far you go, people are alone!"
"That's why we...!", "But!!", "It's precisely because we're alone that...",
rows.notes: Prefilled; kept. Quotes exchanged in the Macross F finale; the Japanese ends on a comma and so does the English.

rows.en: Seize victory from Ranka Lee.

Manipulated by Grace, Ranka Lee guards the Vajra planet to atone for her sins.
Defeat Ranka, who sings to protect the Vajra homeworld.
rows.notes: Prefilled; kept. 'Vajra planet' then 'Vajra homeworld' follows the two different Japanese words.

rows.en: Seize victory from the Vajra Queen.

Even the Protoculture feared their power, envied it, and at last deified them,
copying their form: the super-dimensional Vajra. Defeat Grace's Vajra Queen.
Seize victory from the Mardook fleet.
Seize victory from the Vajra fleet.
Seize victory from the Hound Vajra.
Practice piloting in Fighter mode.

Ranka: "I, Ranka Lee, am gonna explain the basic Fighter mode controls!
        I'm nervous I won't explain it well, but I'll do my best. Kira☆"
Practice piloting in Battroid mode.

Sheryl: "Oh, fine. I'll explain the basic Battroid mode controls for you.
         Sheryl herself is explaining, so don't you dare miss a single word."
Practice piloting in GERWALK mode.

Ranka: "Okay! Next, I'll explain the basic GERWALK mode controls.
        Listen to me and get the GERWALK mode controls down perfectly!"
Practice shooting attacks.

Sheryl: "It's a pain, but next I'll explain the basics of shooting attacks.
         You've got ME explaining, so if you don't learn it, you'll be sorry."
Practice melee attacks.

Ranka: "Umm... here I'll explain the basics of melee attacks.
        It's tough with so much to learn, but I'll do my best explaining too!"
Practice Special Maneuvers 1.

Sheryl: "Here I'll mostly explain the special maneuvers related to piloting.
         If you're aiming to go pro, you'd better learn at least this much."
Practice Special Maneuvers 2.

Ranka: "Here I'll mainly explain the SP-related special maneuvers.
        They look a bit hard, but listen closely and learn them well, okay?"
Practice container transport.

Sheryl: "All right, next I'll explain container transport.
         I'm the one explaining it. Of course you'll pick it up right away."
Practice piloting in Real Flight Mode.

Ranka: "Sheryl and I are going to show you how to fly in Real Flight Mode!"
Sheryl: "You don't get service like this very often, so be grateful."
Practice Special Maneuvers 3.
rows.notes: Matches the prefilled 'Practice Special Maneuvers 1/2' (u3234, u3236).

rows.en:
Sheryl: "I'll explain the special controls for skills and support."
Ranka: "Explaining with Sheryl makes me nervous, but I'll do my best!"
rows.notes: Ranka says 'Sheryl-san'; mission text follows the MUF style without honorifics, as the prefilled u3241 ('Sheryl and I').

rows.en: Practice the Anti-Missile Action.

uncertain: u3243: Ranka says 'Sheryl-san'; mission text follows the MUF style without honorifics, as the prefilled u3241 ('Sheryl and I').

u3200: Prefilled; kept. The Japanese has no real line break but a full-width yen-n (a literal backslash-n written in full-width) between the sentences; the English uses a real line break there. Check how the build handles this row.
